jobs.title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations (Transformation) helps lead the design and delivery of one of AutoNation’s most consequential transformation programs: an enterprise-wide effort to modernize how a leading American automotive retailer operates, with significant P&L impact at scale. Extending across the company’s core businesses and customer experience, the program will build modern, technology-led operating models and carry them from concept to scaled rollout across the network.

This is a builder’s and operator’s role, not only a strategy-deck role. As a core member of the Transformation Office, you will sit at the center of the transformation agenda, with a strategic vantage point across the full scope of work. You will play a key cross-functional role in the effort, collaborating frequently with Product, Tech, Finance, and Operations to drive the high-priority initiatives forward. You will be comfortable structuring ambiguous problems, building the analysis and the executive narrative, and carrying them from approved business case through pilot, rollout, and value capture. You will interact frequently and directly with senior executives, preparing materials for the Executive Committee and presenting them at the senior leadership level.

You operate strategically and in the details. You bring exceptional synthesis and communication skills and mastery of the core strategy toolkit (structured problem solving, Excel modeling, executive-ready PowerPoint), paired with the conviction to push through ambiguity and the willingness to roll up your sleeves and get things done, changing traditional processes into something faster and more customer-centric.

Key Responsibilities:
● Cross-functional ownership: Work cross-functionally to bring workstreams from approved business case through pilot, rollout, and value capture; accountable not for the plan alone, but for the result and its P&L impact.
● Build the analytical backbone: Develop the financial and operational models, KPIs, and reporting that size the opportunity, quantify impact, and hold every initiative accountable to its targets.
● Own the executive narrative: Structure ambiguous problems, translate complex analysis into a single clear point of view, and prepare and deliver Executive Committee- and senior-leadership-level materials with a high bar for accuracy and clarity.
● Translate strategy into execution: Turn enterprise strategy into clear operating plans, roadmaps, milestones, and owners that teams can actually run with.
● Shape the operating model: Help architect target-state operating models, the processes, roles, workflows, and store-level economics, across priority areas of the transformation agenda.
● Drive alignment and governance: Bring leaders across operations, finance, and corporate functions to clear decision points, build adoption in the field, resolve the risks and blockers that stall transformation work, and help manage cross-workstream sequencing and reporting so the program stays honest to its numbers and its timeline.

Minimum Qualifications
● Experience: 7 years of experience across strategy and operations, with a track record of taking cross-functional initiatives from idea to measurable result.
● Executive presence and influence: Superb top-down communication and synthesis skills, and track record of building and owning clear, executive-quality materials. Demonstrated success leading through influence rather than formal hierarchy, building trust across operators, finance, and other functions to deliver enterprise results.
● Comfort with ambiguity: Ability to move from an ambiguous, enterprise-level challenge to a clear execution roadmap autonomously, without waiting to be told how.
● Analytical rigor: Excellent Excel skills and strong financial knowledge, with the judgment to know which analysis actually drives a decision and the discipline to hold initiatives to their numbers.
● Consulting background: Tenure at a top-tier management consulting firm with transformation experience is strongly preferred. Experience in automotive retail, mobility, or multi-brand, multi-unit distributed consumer operations is highly valued.
Education
- BS/BA degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
Exciting Benefits and Perks Await You

Reporting Structure: Reports to the Director of Strategy & Growth Initiatives
Direct Reports: This position is an Individual Contributor (IC)

Exciting Benefits and Perks Await You:
- Competitive compensation and 401k matching

- Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with insurance plans (health, dental, vision) and maternity benefits.

- Associate purchase and discount programs for new and pre-owned vehicles, services, parts, collision, accessories, and AutoGear

- Access amazing deals and discounts through YouDecide, a website with offers from top providers and retailers

- Join our DRVPNK mission to raise and donate millions of dollars to cancer research and treatment, partnering with cancer charities nationwide

AutoNation is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offering innovative products, exceptional services, and comprehensive solutions, empowering our customers to make the best decisions for their needs. With a network of dealerships nationwide strengthened by a recognized brand, we offer a wide variety of new and used vehicles, customer financing, parts, and provide expert maintenance and repair services. Through DRV PNK, we have raised over $40 million for cancer-related causes, demonstrating our commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of our Associates, Customers, and the communities we serve.

AutoNation is committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment in our workplace and the services we provide. jobs.title: Director Strategy Operations Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Strategy & Operations (Transformation) leads the design and delivery of one of AutoNation's most consequential transformation programs: reengineering how the company sells vehicles. Anchored in Sales and Digital Retail, this role builds a modern, technology-led sales operating model — starting with used vehicles and AutoNation USA, then extending across the franchise network and into new cars. It sits at the center of AutoNation's North Star agenda, an enterprise-wide effort to modernize how a leading American automotive retailer sells, with multi-hundred-million-dollar P&L impact at scale.
This is a builder's and operator's role, not a strategy-deck role. As a core member of the transformation office, you will architect the target-state sales operating model — the processes, roles, and workflows — and own the coordination that carries the Sales and Digital Retail workstreams from approved business case through rollout to value capture. You will be the connective tissue across the program, and you will work directly with Brand Presidents and the Chief Operating Officer to translate the model into a multi-brand, multi-franchise environment, accounting for individual brand nuances and OEM requirements as the model scales across the network.
You operate strategically and in the details. You bring the discipline to redesign core business processes and the credibility to win adoption in the field, aligning executives and store operators around hard decisions and pairing exceptional synthesis and communication skills with the conviction to push through ambiguity — changing a traditional model into something faster, more digital, and more customer-centric.

Key Responsibilities
- Architect the sales operating model: Design the target-state Sales and Digital Retail operating model — the processes, roles, workflows, and store-level economics — beginning with used vehicles and AutoNation USA, and bring the new sales operating model to life as a core operating capability.
- Own end-to-end execution: Carry the Sales and Digital Retail workstreams from approved business case through pilot, rollout, and value capture — accountable not for the plan alone, but for the result and its P&L impact.
- Lead Sales Operating model as part of the transformation office: Serve as a core member and coordinating force of the transformation office, managing cross-workstream sequencing, dependencies, governance, and reporting so the program stays honest to its numbers and its timeline.
- Translate the model across brands: Partner with Brand Presidents and the Executive Committee to adapt the operating model to individual brand nuances and OEM requirements in a multi-brand, multi-franchise environment, ensuring the model scales without losing its integrity.
- Scale across the network: Sequence the rollout from used cars and AutoNation USA into the franchise network and new car, proving the model in market and then extending it store by store, region by region.
- Win executive and operator adoption: Align the Executive Committee, Brand Presidents, and store operators around hard decisions on roles, compensation, and process, driving genuine adoption of new best-practice sales processes in the field.
- Build the analytical backbone: Develop the financial and operational models, KPIs, and reporting that size the opportunity, quantify impact, and hold every initiative accountable to its targets.
- Lead change and develop talent: Surface risks early, remove the blockers that stall transformation work, and coach a growing transformation-office bench — setting a high bar for rigor, ownership, and execution.

Minimum Qualifications
- Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise transformation, operating-model redesign, or large-scale operational programs, with a definitive track record of taking cross-functional initiatives from concept to measurable result.
- Operating-model & process redesign: Proven ability to redesign core sales or commercial operating models — processes, roles, and workflows — in a multi-unit or distributed retail environment, and to make the change stick in the field.
- Digital-disruptor playbook: experience adapting a digital-disruptor or direct-to-consumer commercial playbook, translating modern, technology-led retail practices into an established operating environment.
- Influence without authority: Demonstrated success leading through influence rather than formal hierarchy — building trust across operators, finance, and corporate functions and getting teams that don't report to you to deliver.
- Executive presence: Superb communication and synthesis skills, with the gravity to align senior executives and Brand Presidents around difficult decisions and to command a room of experienced operators.
- Analytical rigor: Strong financial and operational modeling, with the judgment to know which analysis actually drives a decision and the discipline to hold initiatives to their numbers.
- Comfort with ambiguity: Ability to move from an ambiguous, enterprise-level challenge to a clear execution roadmap autonomously, without waiting to be told how.
- Industry context: Experience in automotive retail, mobility, or multi-brand, multi-unit distributed consumer operations is strongly preferred.
- Consulting: Post-MBA tenure at a top-tier management consulting firm is a plus; equivalent operating and transformation experience is fully credited and equally valued.

Education
BS/BA degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field; MBA strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager, Marketing Program Management
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager, Marketing Program Management is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and execution of high-priority marketing initiatives across the organization. Reporting to the Director of Program Management, this role serves as a critical partner to Marketing leadership and cross-functional teams, ensuring programs are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and delivered with excellence.

This individual will manage complex, cross-functional marketing projects spanning campaign execution, technology implementations, process improvements, product or promotional launches, customer lifecycle initiatives, and enterprise-wide marketing priorities. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and skilled at balancing strategic oversight with day-to-day execution, while driving accountability across stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Program Leadership

- Lead end-to-end execution of complex marketing projects and programs, from intake and planning through launch, adoption, and post-implementation review.

- Translate business goals into actionable project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and resource requirements.

- Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with competing priorities while maintaining quality, speed, and alignment to business objectives.

- Ensure project scope, risks, assumptions, and decisions are clearly documented and proactively managed throughout the lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Partner closely with Marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, including Creative, Media, CRM, Analytics, Operations, Product, IT, Legal, and external vendors, to drive execution.

- Facilitate project meetings, status reviews, working sessions, and decision forums to maintain momentum and remove roadblocks.

- Build strong relationships across departments to improve collaboration, clarify ownership, and ensure timely delivery of key initiatives.

Planning, Governance & Process Management

- Support the Director of Program Management in establishing and maintaining project governance standards, workflows, and delivery discipline across the Marketing organization.

- Drive project intake, prioritization, timeline development, and workback scheduling for major marketing initiatives.

- Monitor project progress against deadlines, deliverables, budget inputs, and strategic objectives , escalating issues as needed.

- Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve team efficiency, and strengthen project delivery capabilities across the department.

Risk, Change & Issue Management

- Anticipate project risks, dependencies, and constraints, and develop mitigation plans to minimize impact to deliverables and timelines.

- Manage changes to scope, timeline, or stakeholder expectations with clear communication and documented alignment.

- Escalate critical risks and decisions to the Director of Program Management and senior stakeholders with recommendations for resolution.

Communication & Reporting

- Provide clear, concise, and actionable status reporting to project teams, department leadership, and executive stakeholders.

- Prepare project updates, dashboards, and summaries that communicate progress, risks, business impact, and next steps.

- Ensure alignment across teams through timely communication, transparent documentation, and proactive follow-up.

Execution Excellence

- Drive accountability for deliverables across matrixed teams without direct authority.

- Maintain a high standard of organization, detail, and follow-through to ensure seamless execution.

- Support a culture of operational rigor, continuous improvement, and results -driven project management within Marketing.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing , Business, Communications, Project Management, or related field.

- 5–8+ years of project management, program management, or marketing operations experience, preferably within a complex, fast-paced marketing environment.

- Proven experience leading large-scale, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.

- Strong understanding of marketing workflows, campaign development processes, and integrated go-to-market execution.

- Excellent organizational, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

- Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, solve problems, and drive execution in matrixed environments.

- Proficiency in project management tools such as Asana, Workfront, Monday.com, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.

- Strong presentation and reporting skills, including the ability to distill complex information into executive-ready updates.

Preferred

- Experience in a corporate marketing, retail, consumer, or multi-channel business environment.

- PMP, CAPM, Agile, Scrum, or other project/program management certification.

- Experience supporting marketing technology, customer journey, campaign, or operational transformation initiatives.

- Familiarity with budgeting, resource planning, and change management principles.

Core Competencies

- Cross-functional collaboration

- Strategic planning and prioritization

- Risk and issue management

- Process improvement

Success Measures / Key Performance Indicators

- On-time and on-budget delivery of assigned marketing initiatives

- Achievement of project milestones and launch readiness

- Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional alignment

- Reduction in project bottlenecks, delays, and execution issues

jobs.title: Senior Manager Operations
jobs.description:
AutoNation is transforming AN USA into a next-generation, digitally enabled, centrally coordinated operating model. The Senior Manager of Operations will serve as one of the core architects of this transformation. This leader will design, operationalize, and own the performance outcomes of new customer and operational workflows across AN USA — from digital retail and credit integration to BDC workflows and vehicle acquisition processes.

This role is not about maintaining existing processes. It is about building them from the ground up, refining them through real-world execution, and scaling them across AN USA and ultimately into the Franchise network. You will be part of the core 'brain trust' defining how the future of auto retail operates at scale.

What You Will Own:
• Architect new end-to-end operating processes
• Translate product concepts into executable store-level workflows
• Own rollout, adoption, and performance outcomes
• Refine processes until stated objectives are achieved
• Scale proven models into the broader Franchise network

Key Responsibilities
1. Process Architecture & Design
• Design zero-to-one operational workflows across sales, credit, BDC integration, WBYC, and vehicle allocation
• Provide critical input to Product and Technology teams on operational feasibility and execution design
• Represent the voice of the dealer in shaping customer journeys into real store operations

2. Outcome Ownership & Performance Optimization
• Own measurable performance outcomes including close rate improvement and productivity gains
• Monitor execution in pilot stores and refine processes until objectives are met
• Ensure workflows are scalable, cost-effective, and repeatable

3. Pilot Rollout & Field Implementation
• Lead in-market rollout of newly designed workflows
• Travel to BOS (Dallas) and AN USA stores for discovery, implementation, and oversight
• Partner with Head of Change Management and Dealer Performance Managers to co-develop rollout cadence and training playbooks
• Provide in-store support to ensure processes are embedded before scaling

4. Franchise Scalability
• Adapt proven AN USA processes for Franchise deployment
• Anticipate and manage increased complexity in franchise environments

5. Cross-Functional Leadership
• Work closely with Product, Technology, Central BDC, AN Finance, Pricing & Inventory, Legal, Compliance, and Corporate teams
• Maintain strong written documentation of workflows and process maps
• Communicate clearly across stakeholders to align execution

Why This Role Matters
This role sits at the center of AutoNation’s used car transformation. The Senior Manager of Operations will help define, build, and scale the operating model that enables seamless digital-to-store journeys, higher productivity per store, stronger central coordination, and enterprise scalability.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Corporate Real Estate
jobs.description:
Serves and the central subject matter expert on project workloads, timelines, and milestone commitments. This role provides daily management of all Corporate Real Estate Services (CRES) facility project milestones and acts as a critical liaison across internal departments – including Design, Construction, Facilities, and IT – as well as external A&E vendors. Maintains and constantly improves database and document standards. Supports the CRES Development & Facilities teams in preparing Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs) for projects, including compiling submitted information, populating standard templates, and assembling supporting documentation needed for approval. Follows and tracks each CER through the approval cycle including logging and uploading documents into the CRES project management system.

Key Responsibilities:

40%                      Project Management & Milestone Tracking:
Milestone Oversight: Serve as the subject matter expert on CRES project workloads, managing daily commitments and tracking facility project milestones to ensure on-time project delivery. Cross-Functional Liaison: Coordinate with the entire CRES Development Team to monitor project health, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain strict alignment with required timelines. Action Log Management: Manage, continuously develop and improve project action logs and milestone tracking; ensure reporting is accurate, up to date, and diligently follow up on outstanding items with the CRES Development Team.

25%                      Design Standards & OEM Compliance
Roll-out Implementation: Support the Senior Director of Design in executing strategic roll-out initiatives for both OEM and AN facility programs. Reference Material/Standards Stewardship: Ensure manufacturer reference materials contain the most current information regarding design standards, facility requirements, and required OEM-specific vendors.
20%                      CER Management & Administration:
CER Preparation: Support the CRES and Facility Maintenance departments in preparing project CERs by compiling submitted data, populating standardized templates, gathering essential supporting documentation, and ensuring accuracy. CER Approvals: Process the approved CERs within the project management system, executing the full approval cycle workflow including logging, cataloging, scanning, and document upload.
15%                      CRES Database Management:
Lead efforts for ensuring facility database documentation is accurate and up to date by leading project reviews with the CRES Development Team at the conclusion of each project and reconciling facility datasheets against architectural drawings. Manage and direct AN’s contracted database architect to identify and resolve discrepancies within the database.

Interacts with:
CRES members (development & facilities maintenance), A&E teams, inter-company departments (Operations, Customer Care, M&A, Marketing, etc.), external vendors.

Qualifications (Mandatory):
- 5 – 7 years minimum practical project management/administration experience preferably with a focus on corporate real estate, architecture, development/construction coordination or facilities management.
- Exceptional organizational skills with a proven track record of managing complex project roll outs, timelines and cross-functional action logs.
- Strong understanding of design and construction processes.
- Strong verbal, written, and graphic communication skills.
- Proficiency in project management software, document management systems, and financial workflows.

Qualifications (Preferred):
Retail program management or program roll out experience as an owner’s representative, real estate development or construction scheduling experience. Familiarity with OEM/automotive facility programs and design standards.
